# Verification Phase

Perform the final technical verification of the implementation.

## Required Inputs

Read:

- docs/requirements.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/design-review.md
- docs/implementation-plan.md
- implemented source code
- implemented tests
- .github/skills/verification.skill.md

## Tasks

Verify:

- Build
- Unit tests
- Integration tests where applicable
- Functional requirements
- Acceptance criteria
- Error handling
- Edge cases
- Missing data scenarios
- Security requirements
- Regression behavior
- Documentation output

Run the appropriate Maven verification commands.

Do not duplicate implementation work.

## Output

Create:

`docs/verification.md`

Include:

- Verification Scope
- Environment
- Commands Executed
- Test Results
- Requirements Traceability
- Acceptance Criteria Results
- Edge Cases
- Security Verification
- Build Result
- Known Limitations
- Final Verification Recommendation
- Approval Status

Set:

`Approval Status: PENDING`

Do not modify application code unless a critical verification defect requires
human-approved remediation.
